english: Objection This that you have explained would be an instance of the superiority of Direct Assertion and not of Syntactical Connec tion. Reply The indication in question is not due to any particular word of the mantra, as the Injunctive affix does not denote the agent it is got at by means of a coordination based upon the indications due to the proximity of two words which constitutes Syntactical Connection and hence it is a case of the supersession of Name by Syntactical Connee tion.
